label: Research & Inquiry
raw_text: Build knowledge about the world by asking or generating questions about topics of interest, researching the answers, using multiple sources, and communicating relevant and accurate information about the topic.
child_texts: Ask questions about topics of interest for research. (I)

Work collaboratively or individually to conduct research on a shared or personal topic of interest by gathering and organizing information from provided sources (including print, digital, and personal communication) using graphic organizers or other support aids. (I)
Share relevant and accurate information through a variety of different modes. (C)
competency_statement: Students ask questions about topics they are interested in, research answers using multiple sources, and share accurate information in different ways.
observable_behaviors: Ask questions about topics they want to learn more about.
Gather and organize information from print, digital, and personal communication sources.
Use graphic organizers or other tools to help organize research information.
Work alone or with others to conduct research on a topic.
Share information they found using speaking, writing, or other communication methods.
skill_clauses: Ask questions about topics of interest for research.
Conduct research individually or collaboratively by gathering and organizing information from multiple sources using graphic organizers or support aids.
Share relevant and accurate information through different communication modes.
